description.value: Sprinkles Gelato and Dessert House is a gelato and dessert shop located in Steveston, the historic fishing village neighbourhood of Richmond, BC. Steveston sits at the terminus of popular cycling routes including the West Dyke Trail and the Steveston Scenic Loop, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring the Fraser River delta.
